B7.limitations: Four lifecycle states for the nominated target goal; a real HMM with EM, not SIPS/BToM reproduction or full joint cognition. It does not model planning, continuous elapsed time or variable horizons; compare only matched horizons. Step head uses ungated persistent progress; no learned step probabilities. Semantic C probabilities are emitted only if all four states have nonempty training evidence anchors; otherwise only a latent posterior is logged.
